ACCEPTED by the maintainer (2026-11-03): no context-only mask, no loss re-weighting
stage3_packing.validation: every validation document, packed the same way, with no sequence cap (a 16-sequence cap after the shuffle kept a random part of each category); the pack record lists the training data types the validation set does not cover

Packed sequences, non-padding, repeated, truncated and padding tokens and supervised-token exposure are packing / compute / exposure measures only and never redefine a size or a share; no loss weight corrects a quota. Proportions are checked by the data admission (data_admission below), never by the packing
stage3_packing.epoch_order: the trainer's per-epoch permutation of the packed sequences (train.stream_block_indices); no re-packing between epochs

data_admission.steps: packed_packs.select (whole examples and episodes, the tool cells per the frozen generation plan, a short cell SHORTFALL) -> packed_packs.proportions (unique supervised tokens before packing, aadistill.data.mixture.validate_proportions against packed_packs.registered_quotas; the report carries the selection's content identity and its own seal) -> packed_packs.admit (only the selection its report validated: packed_packs.report_problems recomputes the identity, never the proportions; the frozen <pack>/data_manifest.json, or AdmissionError and nothing written) -> packed_packs.pack (token_documents.pack_sequential at stage3_packing; its input must be the manifest's documents; records the packed content identity before writing) -> packed_training_plan.bind (only a pack packed_packs.verify_pack accepts, its actual tokens and supervision included)

Empty: nothing is approved

data_admission.pack_content: maintainer 2026-11-04 (review of 647eea0e, P1; truncation, review of 2468c1aa): pack records packed_content_sha256 -- the token ids, supervision mask and content mask of every sequence, named, dtype- and shape-normalized, with the training-sequence count -- from the sequences the packing produced, before writing them; the admission freezes the documents themselves beside the manifest (data_documents.npz, its sha256 in the manifest, schema data_manifest/v2). verify_pack (the training binding) recomputes the identity from blocks.npz and requires it, then checks the frozen documents against the manifest and re-packs them by the formal algorithm at the design's spec -- truncation of an overlong document and the prefix restarts included -- which must reproduce every sequence and placement; the bound lineage carries packed_content_sha256 and the manifest's content_sha256 beside the files' sha256
